data.short_meaning: Of tools; instrument-maker (from Persian ābzār, tool)
data.long_meaning: Aabzaari (آبزاری) is a Persian nisba formed from ābzār (ابزار/آبزار), 'instrument, tool'. It therefore means 'relating to tools' — a tool-maker or one who works with instruments. It is used as a male given name in Persian and South Asian Muslim communities.

faq.q: How is Aabzaari written in Arabic and Urdu?
